# PrefixField reorders fast keystrokes and leaves rapid multi-field fills unmasked

## Context

Promoted from `@neo-opus-ada`'s defect-note (`MESSAGE:671786e5`, observed on `examples/fieldWithPrefix` at `dev` `53ed5d36e5` while capturing covers for #21551 under #21329):
- Typing into a `Neo.plugin.PrefixField`-masked `TextField` faster than an App-Worker round trip (`pressSequentially` with `0 ms` delay or fast typing) reorders and mangles characters — e.g. date `201120260930` becomes `02/60/9302 01:1m`, and MAC `ABCDEF` becomes `DE:FA:BX:XX:XX:XX`.
- Filling five masked fields back-to-back without artificial ~`700 ms` pauses (`fill()` / paste / autofill) leaves fields 2–4 raw/unmasked and the Credit Card field empty.
- Also blocks reliable Playwright typing verification on contributor GFI #21502 (`AC-1`: typing `001A2B3C4D5E` into the MAC Address field).

## The Problem

`Neo.plugin.PrefixField` (`src/plugin/PrefixField.mjs:127-136, 207-226`) currently performs live DOM input masking and caret placement asynchronously from the App Worker:

1. **Cross-thread VDOM/caret clobber on fast keystrokes:** `PrefixField` listens to `selectionchange`, `keydown`, `focusin`, and `focusout` in the App Worker, sets `el.value = clean(value).join('')` (triggering an async VDOM delta), and calls `Neo.main.DomAccess.selectNode(...)` (an async RMA call) while setting `me.ignoreSelection = true` and immediately `me.ignoreSelection = false` synchronously before the RMA even crosses to Main (`:220-223`). Any keystroke arriving on the Main Thread `<input>` before the worker VDOM delta + `selectNode` return gets overwritten or inserted at a stale caret index.
2. **Missed `fill()` / paste events without `selectionchange`:** `src/plugin/PrefixField.mjs:131-136` never listens to `input` at all — it relies on `document`'s `selectionchange`, which browsers coalesce per frame/activeElement and do not emit per field across rapid programmatic `fill()` or autofill sequences.
3. **Orphan single-instance `src/main/addon/PrefixField.mjs`:** An experimental `Neo.main.addon.PrefixField` (`src/main/addon/PrefixField.mjs:1-139`) already ships as a lazy Main-Thread addon chunk in every build, but is completely unwired, stores single-element state (`this.el`, `this.pattern`, `this.back`) on the singleton instead of per-element in a `Map` (breaking multi-field views like `examples/fieldWithPrefix`'s 5 inputs), listens to `keypress` (which never fires for `Backspace`), and leaves `console.log` in `format()` (`:126`).
4. **RegExp flag loss in `clean()`:** `new RegExp(this.accept || "\\d", "g")` (`src/plugin/PrefixField.mjs:193`) strips flags like `'i'` when `accept` is a case-insensitive `RegExp` (e.g. `/[0-9a-f]/i`).

## The Architectural Reality

- **Design authority:** `examples/fieldWithPrefix/MainContainer.mjs:15` (*"Type into a field: the mask fills its slots as you go and refuses characters it does not accept"*) and `src/form/field/Text.mjs:1550-1557` (*"The user's input has changed the real DOM on the Main Thread. We must manually update our 'last known state' (`this.vnode`) to match this reality before the next diffing cycle runs. This prevents the framework from sending a redundant delta update that could overwrite the user's input or cause cursor jumps."*).
- **`src/main/DomEvents.mjs:11-15, 565-581, 642-651`:** `DomEvents` delegates `input`, `keydown`, `focusin`, and `focusout` in bubble phase on `document.body`, and `onChange(event)` reads `value: target.value`. Therefore, direct target-phase listeners on the `<input>` element inside `Neo.main.addon.PrefixField` execute **synchronously on the Main Thread before `DomEvents#onChange` reads `target.value`**:
  - On `input`: `<input>.value` and `setSelectionRange(i, j)` settle synchronously on Main before the next keystroke AND before `DomEvents#onChange` forwards `{type: 'input', value: masked}` to `TextField#onInputValueChange`, which updates `inputVNode.attributes.value` and `reportedInputValue` without emitting a clobbering worker-to-main `value` delta.
  - On `focusin` / `focusout`: when focus shows the empty mask template or blur clears an unfilled template (`el.value === pattern`), dispatching a bubbling `input` event from `<input>` (guarded against re-entry) synchronizes `TextField` in FIFO order *before* `focusout` reaches `TextField#onFocusLeave` (resolving to `TextField#emptyValue`).

## The Fix

1. **Promote `Neo.main.addon.PrefixField` (`src/main/addon/PrefixField.mjs`) into the multi-instance Main-Thread mask controller:**
   - Key per-input state in `this.fields = new Map()` (`id -> {el, accept, pattern, slots, prev, first, back, formatting, listeners}`), removing singleton `this.el` state and `console.log`.
   - Expose `remote.app`: `register`, `setConfigs`, `unregister` (matching `test/playwright/setup.mjs:58-62`).
   - Handle `keydown` (`Backspace` tracking), `input` (synchronous `clean` + `setSelectionRange` before `DomEvents#onChange`), `focusin` (template display + caret at first unfilled slot), `click` (snap collapsed caret into valid slot range when clicking outside filled slots while preserving range selections), and `focusout` (clear untouched `pattern` to `''` before `DomEvents#onFocusOut`).
   - Preserve `RegExp` flags (`'i'`, `'u'`) alongside `'g'` when compiling `accept`.
2. **Wire `Neo.plugin.PrefixField` (`src/plugin/PrefixField.mjs`) to `Neo.main.addon.PrefixField`:**
   - Remove the async App-Worker `selectionchange` / `keydown` / `focusin` / `focusout` DOM listeners and broken synchronous `ignoreSelection` toggle around `DomAccess.selectNode`.
   - Load `Neo.currentWorker.getAddon('PrefixField', owner.windowId)` on `onOwnerMounted()` (supporting remounts per `Neo.plugin.Base` and `destroy()` cleanup via `unregister`), forwarding serialized `{id: owner.getInputElId(), acceptSource, acceptFlags, pattern, slots, windowId}` on `register` and `setConfigs`.
   - Retain `clean(input)` (with `RegExp` flag preservation) and wrap `owner.beforeSetValue` (restored in `destroy()`) in the App Worker so Node unit specs and programmatic `field.value = ...` mutations format atomically without DOM round-trips.
3. **Add Playwright unit + real-browser component coverage:**
   - `test/playwright/unit/plugin/PrefixField.spec.mjs`: unit coverage for `clean()`, `RegExp` flag preservation (`/[0-9a-f]/i`), programmatic `TextField` value formatting, and `register`/`setConfigs`/`unregister` lifecycle.
   - `test/playwright/component/form/field/PrefixField.spec.mjs`: real OMT browser test mounting five masked `TextField`s and verifying zero-delay `pressSequentially('201120260930')` (`'20/11/2026 09:30'`), zero-delay MAC keystrokes, five consecutive pause-free `fill()` calls across all five `fieldWithPrefix` masks, `Backspace` across separators, untouched focus/blur clearing, and live runtime config updates.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Zero-delay back-to-back keystrokes (`pressSequentially` with `delay: 0`) in a real browser OMT `TextField` with `Neo.plugin.PrefixField` preserve exact character order and slot separators (e.g. `'201120260930'` in `dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm` → `'20/11/2026 09:30'`; `'ABCDEF123456'` in hex MAC mask → `'AB:CD:EF:12:34:56'`).
- [ ] AC-2: Consecutive pause-free `fill()` calls across five masked `TextField`s in one container mask every field and synchronize `TextField#value` in the App Worker without dropping or leaving raw values.
- [ ] AC-3: Focusing an empty masked field displays `pattern` at the first slot, blurring without accepted input clears `<input>.value` to `''` and `TextField#value` to `emptyValue` (`null`), `Backspace` steps back across literal separators, and runtime `pattern`/`slots`/`accept` config updates re-sync the live mask.
- [ ] AC-4: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/plugin/PrefixField.spec.mjs` and `npm run test-components -- test/playwright/component/form/field/PrefixField.spec.mjs` pass (and fail on `dev` before the fix).

## Out of Scope

- Changing `examples/fieldWithPrefix/MainContainer.mjs` phone-width sizing or MAC label/config (`#21502`, reserved for external contributor pickup).
- Modifying `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` (`#21552`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Keeping masking in App-Worker `selectionchange` with `await DomAccess.selectNode`:** Even awaiting the RMA leaves a full worker round-trip gap during which fast native keystrokes land at unformatted indices on Main.
- **Singleton `this.el` field state in `Neo.main.addon.PrefixField`:** Clobbers earlier masked fields whenever a page mounts more than one `PrefixField` (`examples/fieldWithPrefix` mounts five).
- **Mutating `examples/fieldWithPrefix/MainContainer.mjs`:** Collides with open contributor GFI `#21502`.
